additional_info.subject: Notes from NOC to ES
additional_info.body:
Need to Answer following query.
Both charging stations have RCD circuit breakers for AC type A sockets, but they should be type B.
Please advise urgently on what to do in this situation. Can the type A RCD remain (I think this is not compliant with the standard)? Do
we need to replace the RCD? There seems to have been an error at the factory, as this also does not match the SCB station diagram.
I suspect that the stations:
Y2/S2 314164726002 - station awaiting release in our warehouse
Y2/S2 314164726003 - RCD A
Y2/S2 314164726004 - RCD A
Y2/S2 314164726005 - station awaiting release in our warehouse
The case is urgent because the station will soon be inspected by
the Technical Inspection Authority.
The photos are labeled with the location in the lower left corner.

additional_info.body:
Hello colleagues,
The schematic is only wrong on the first page.
The  other places is showing Type A.
I have no information yet why we decided to replace it to Type-A. Also this not part of MLFB so, I believe that could be assembled this way in all new chargers.
The spare parts list only have the Type-B available.
Tomorrow I will try to clarify together with factory and serviceability to get more conclusions.
